test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

A _ P L _ _ Z _ L M _ _ P L M A Z P _ _
solution:
Given series: A _ P L _ _ Z _ L M _ _ P L M A Z P _ _

Option 1) MZAPAZLM → A __M__ P L __Z__ __A__ Z __P__ L M __A__ __Z__ P L M A Z P __L__ __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) MZPAAZML → A __M__ P L __Z__ __P__ Z __A__ L M __A__ __Z__ P L M A Z P __M__ __L__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ZMPAAZLM → A __Z__ P L __M__ __P__ Z __A__ L M __A__ __Z__ P L M A Z P __L__ __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) ZMAPAZLM → A __**Z**__ P L __**M**__ __**A**__ Z __**P**__ L M __**A**__ __**Z**__ P L M A Z P __**L**__ __**M**__ → (It follows the pattern of: AZPLM - AZPLM - AZPLM - AZPLM)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
